name: Proline
info: The side chain closes back onto the nitrogen, forming a secondary amino group. It restricts chain flexibility and often disrupts an α-helix.

history.clue: The name is shortened from “pyrrolidine,” the name of the saturated five-membered ring.
history.story: Proline was synthesized in 1900 and found among the components of proteins a year later. It was initially called pyrrolidine-α-carboxylic acid. In 1904, Emil Fischer proposed the abbreviation “proline,” because the long name was inconvenient when describing peptides. The short name retained a reference to the five-membered pyrrolidine ring.
